headline: Bell's First 505 for Aerial Policing Work in Asia Pacific Commences Operations
summary: NAGOYA, Japan, August 04, 2026--The Aichi Prefectural Police have commenced aerial policing operations utilizing the Bell 505, marking a landmark moment in the Asia-Pacific region.
